description: This file contains utility functions for handling file paths, reading and writing JSON files, running Vitest test reports, and collecting test durations from Vitest reports. It appears to be a module providing auxiliary test-report utilities for a testing setup within a JavaScript project.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a repository path to a normalized string with '/' as separator.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a repo-relative or absolute path to a consistent relative path format.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the filesystem.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file, returning a fallback on failure.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Runs Vitest tests with a JSON reporter, stores the report at a specified or temporary path.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Aggregates test durations from a Vitest report object.
